_README: Cited Frohlich-polaron input parameters (eps_inf, eps_static, LO phonon, m*) for spec F6 (polaron.py). Values ONLY from cited primary sources (no fabrication); collected by Claude Code via OA per PI authorization 2026-05-24. eps_inf here are the values used in the cited polaron study (may differ from the project's MP-DFPT eps_inf in eps_inf_external.json, which is the bare electronic value from a different method).
_alpha_formula: Frost 2017 PRB 96 195202 (arXiv:1704.05404): alpha = (1/4pi eps0)(1/2)(1/eps_inf - 1/eps_static)(e^2/hbar/Omega) sqrt(2 m_b Omega/hbar), Omega = LO angular frequency.

MAPbI3.source: J. M. Frost, Phys. Rev. B 96, 195202 (2017), arXiv:1704.05404 (verified OA 2026-05-24)
MAPbI3.note: benchmark used to validate the alpha SI prefactor; not a CsBX3 material

CsPbBr3.source: A. D. Sendner et al. (Frohlich interaction dominated by a single phonon mode in CsPbBr3), Nat. Commun. 12, 4945 (2021), PMC8494801 (verified OA 2026-05-24)
CsPbBr3.note: second independent benchmark; single dominant LO mode M0 = 155 cm^-1 (19.2 meV); alpha ~= 2 (intermediate coupling) for both carriers

_tb_driven_alpha._README: TB-DRIVEN Frohlich alpha (T1-3): the band effective mass m_b is taken from the CORE Kashikar-13 TB (bandstructure.effective_mass at the R point; see results/tb_effective_masses.json), combined with the CITED dielectric/LO data above. This is the property computed END-TO-END from the TB (per the user constraint), distinct from the formula-validation tests that reuse each paper's own m*.

CsPbBr3.honest_note: alpha_TB=1.66 vs Sendner alpha~2.0. The -17% gap is ENTIRELY the band-mass ratio: alpha ~ sqrt(m_b), and the TB R-point mass m_e=0.151 is lighter than the m*=0.22 Sendner adopted; sqrt(0.151/0.22)=0.83. The alpha FORMULA reproduces Sendner exactly given m*=0.22 (test_cspbbr3_sendner_alpha). Category: A for the formula; the TB-driven absolute reflects the TB band mass (SK-TB).

_pending: TB-driven alpha for the other 8 CsBX3 is gated on CITED eps_static/eps_inf/omega_LO (the TB already provides m* for all 9 in results/tb_effective_masses.json). A clean primary-source dielectric/LO pair was located only for CsPbBr3 (Sendner 2021) so far; CsPbCl3/CsPbI3/CsGeX3/CsSnX3 not yet cited-verified (no fabrication). frohlich_alpha() can be applied to each once cited values are added here.
